name: Madaran rift
description: Rift in Madara where Leshrac ambushed the party and Bolas ended him.

timeline.summary: At the Madaran rift Leshrac strips Jeska of Phage's powers and attacks Nicol Bolas, paralyzing him and rotting his body.
timeline.quote: Leshrac and Bolas battled both by spells and claw

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "Leshrac's Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas impales Leshrac, reveals he already defeated Night's Reach, traps Leshrac in the true mask and uses it to close the Madaran rift, ending him.
timeline.quote: effectively ending the Walker of the Night's existence
